Cyber Security


Popular node-ipc npm Package Compromised in Supply Chain Attack


May 15, 24:00


Hackers injected credential-stealing malware into newly published versions of node-ipc, a popular JavaScript inter-process communication package used by thousands of developers. The supply chain attack targets npm repositories to steal developer credentials and authentication tokens. This follows the recent Shai-Hulud worm campaign that compromised hundreds of packages across npm and PyPI repositories.


Critical development tool compromise affects thousands of JavaScript projects and demonstrates ongoing vulnerability of open source package ecosystems


Sources: BleepingComputer


CISA Orders Federal Agencies to Patch Critical Cisco SD-WAN Bug by Sunday


May 15, 24:00


CISA added a new Cisco SD-WAN vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, requiring federal agencies to patch by Sunday. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication and gain administrative privileges on affected systems. This marks another critical network infrastructure vulnerability requiring immediate attention.


Maximum severity network infrastructure vulnerability affecting federal agencies and enterprises using Cisco SD-WAN systems


Sources: The Record


Shai-Hulud Worm Steals Credentials from npm, GitHub, AWS, and Kubernetes


May 15, 24:00


The self-propagating Shai-Hulud malware is tunneling through developer environments to steal credentials from npm, GitHub, AWS, and Kubernetes simultaneously. Hundreds of malicious packages have been tied to this campaign, making it one of 2026's most alarming supply chain threats. The worm demonstrates sophisticated capabilities for multi-platform credential theft across development infrastructure.


Major supply chain threat targeting the entire developer ecosystem could compromise thousands of applications and cloud infrastructure


Sources: Cybersecurity News


Turla Transforms Kazuar Backdoor Into Modular P2P Botnet


May 15, 24:00


Russian state-sponsored group Turla has evolved its custom Kazuar backdoor into a modular peer-to-peer botnet designed for stealth and persistent access to compromised systems. The FSB-affiliated group's enhanced malware demonstrates sophisticated command-and-control capabilities that are harder to detect and disrupt. The transformation represents a significant advancement in nation-state persistent access tools.


Nation-state malware evolution demonstrates increasingly sophisticated persistent access capabilities that could affect critical infrastructure


Sources: The Hacker News

May 15, 24:00


Four critical vulnerabilities in OpenClaw, a fast-growing open-source AI agent platform, have left an estimated 245,000 publicly accessible server instances exposed to remote exploitation. The vulnerability chain enables credential theft and persistent backdoor installation on systems running autonomous AI agents. The flaws affect one of the most popular platforms for connecting large language models to filesystems and applications.


Massive AI agent platform vulnerability could enable widespread compromise of autonomous AI systems and connected infrastructure


Sources: Cybersecurity News

May 15, 24:00


Cybercriminals are exploiting Microsoft's OAuth device authorization flow to steal account credentials at scale through device code phishing campaigns. The attacks manipulate a legitimate security feature, turning it into a vulnerability that targets organizations worldwide. This emerging threat has surged dramatically since late 2024, catching security teams unprepared.


Authentication system exploitation could compromise Microsoft 365 access for millions of users through legitimate security mechanisms


Sources: Cybersecurity News

May 15, 24:00


OpenAI announced ChatGPT will soon allow users to securely connect their bank accounts through Plaid, enabling the AI to access financial data from over 12,000 institutions including Chase, Capital One, and Fidelity. The feature will provide personalized financial advice by analyzing spending patterns, budgets, and investment portfolios. The integration represents a significant expansion of AI into personal financial management.

May 15, 24:00


OpenAI has reorganized its executive ranks with Greg Brockman officially taking control of the company's product division as part of efforts to unify ChatGPT and Codex into one core experience. The restructuring comes amid ongoing legal battles and represents another significant leadership change at the influential AI company. Anthropic warned the US government that authoritarian regimes could set global AI rules unless Washington tightens chip export controls and model restrictions before 2028. The warning reflects growing concerns about AI competition and national security implications.

Microsoft Copilot Studio leads with 38.6% adoption, while Anthropic made its first appearance at 5.7% for native orchestration workflows. The disclosure highlights ongoing security challenges in mobile device protection.

The decision represents a notable shift in how companies approach security testing.


AI-driven code quality improvements could transform how companies approach security testing and vulnerability management

Oil markets rose after President Trump's meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping failed to secure commitments to help end the Iran conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The S&P 500's lengthy winning streak faces challenges from accelerating inflation and possible Federal Reserve interest rate increases, despite strong corporate earnings continuing to drive markets higher. President Trump announced a Boeing jet order from China during the summit, but Beijing has remained silent on the deal's details or confirmation. The lack of Chinese confirmation raises questions about the deal's reality and scope.

European Union business investment rates fell to their lowest point since 2015, with companies citing geopolitical disruption, tariffs, weak demand, and climate regulation uncertainty. Critical Windows security bypass affecting millions of systems relying on BitLocker for data protection
